Seasons.Text: The year in Stardew Valley is divided into 4 seasons each 28 days long. The seasons are:

Summer.Name: Summer
Summer.Description: Warm and sunny weather with occasional thunderstorms.

Fall.Name: Fall
Fall.Description: Cool and crisp weather with sporadic rain.

Locations.Text: The action in Stardew Valley includes the following buildings and places:

TheFarm.Name: The Farm
TheFarm.Description: The farmer's home and main center of action. Farm buildings include Barn, Coop, Greenhouse, Silo, Stable, Shed, and Fish Pond.

PelicanTown_SeedShop.Name: Pierre's General Store
PelicanTown_SeedShop.Description: Sells seeds and produce. Owned by Pierre, who lives there with his wife Caroline and daughter Abigail.

PelicanTown_JojaMart.Name: JojaMart
PelicanTown_JojaMart.Description: Corporate store competing with Pierre's. Employs Shane, Emily, and Morris.

PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Name: Stardrop Saloon
PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Description: Social hub owned by Gus. Offers food, drinks, pool, and arcade games.

PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Name: Harvey's Clinic
PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Description: Town doctor's office, run by Harvey.

PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Name: Blacksmith
PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Description: Owned by Clint. Upgrades tools and processes geodes.

PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Name: Library & Museum
PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Description: Run by Gunther. Displays donated artifacts and minerals.

PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Name: Community Center
PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Description: Formerly the social heart of town, now dilapidated. Can be restored or converted into a Joja Warehouse.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: Contains Leah's Cottage, Marnie's Ranch, and the Wizard's Tower. Visited by Travelling Cart on Fri/Sun.

CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Name: Marnie's Ranch
CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Description: Sells animals and supplies. Marnie lives here with Jas and Shane.

CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Name: Wizard's Tower
CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Description: Home to the Wizard. Regarded with suspicion by most villagers.

Mountain.Name: Mountain
Mountain.Description: North of town. Contains Robin's Carpenter Shop, Linus's tent, the Mines, and the Adventurer's Guild.

Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Name: Adventurer's Guild
Mountain_AdventurersGuild.Description: Run by Marlon. Frequented by adventurers including Abigail and Sebastian.

Mountain_TheMines.Name: The Mines
Mountain_TheMines.Description: Dangerous and monster-filled. Regularly explored by the farmer, Clint, Abigail, Linus, and Sebastian.

Mountain_Spa.Name: Spa
Mountain_Spa.Description: Swimming pool and gym near the railroad. Pool restores energy and health.

Beach_FishShop.Name: Fish Shop
Beach_FishShop.Description: Run by Willy. Sells fishing supplies. Ferry to Ginger Island departs from here once repaired.

Desert_Oasis.Name: Oasis
Desert_Oasis.Description: Sandy's shop in the Calico Desert. Sells rare seeds including cactus, starfruit, and beet. Accessible once the bus is repaired.

GingerIsland.Name: Ginger Island
GingerIsland.Description: Tropical island off the coast. Contains a resort, farm, and exotic wildlife. Accessible once Willy's boat is repaired.

Festivals.Text: The year in Pelican Town features a number of important festivals. These are:

spring24.Name: Flower Dance
spring24.Description: **Spring 24** - Dance festival. Players can ask an eligible villager to be their partner.

summer11.Name: Luau
summer11.Description: **Summer 11** - Beach potluck festival. Players contribute to a communal soup.

summer28.Name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
summer28.Description: **Summer 28** - Evening festival watching glowing jellyfish migrate.

fall16.Name: Stardew Valley Fair
fall16.Description: **Fall 16** - Fair with mini-games and a Grange Display competition.

fall27.Name: Spirit's Eve
fall27.Description: **Fall 27** - Halloween-style festival with a haunted maze.

winter8.Name: Festival of Ice
winter8.Description: **Winter 8** - Ice fishing competition in Cindersap Forest.

winter25.Name: Feast of the Winter Star
winter25.Description: **Winter 25** - Gift-giving celebration with a secret gift-giver draw.
